big_case.notes: While the underlying Anti-Terrorism Act litigation carries a $655.5 million trebled verdict against the PLO and Palestinian Authority and follows the Court's merits decision in Fuld v. PLO, 606 U.S. 1 (2025), this follow-on cert petition turned on a sui generis mandate-recall posture under PSJVTA section 903(d)(2) with a parallel 2018 action stayed below, drew waivers from both private respondents and the Solicitor General with zero amicus briefs, and ended in a summary first-conference denial without dissent.
